name: scrubber
title: Scrubber
description: A compact stack of horizontal sliders where each label sits inside its track. Dragging along the bar changes the value in steps, with tick marks and a readout, and a preview shape reacts.
use: A settings panel needs several numeric values adjusted quickly by dragging, the way design tools treat opacity.
avoid: Fine control is limited to the step and there is no text entry, so exact values are easiest set with arrow keys.
a11y: Keyboard and aria values are handled, but there is no aria-valuetext, so the formatted number is only visible on screen. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: On a near-black stage a small grey panel titled 'LAYER · HERO SHAPE' stacks four rounded tracks labelled Opacity, Radius, Rotation and Blur. Each track has its label at the left, faint ticks across the middle, a slim vertical thumb and a monospaced number at the right.
behaves: Pressing and dragging along a track moves the thumb and updates the number, snapping to the step, while a gradient square on the left changes corner radius, tilt or blur. Hovering or dragging swells and brightens the thumb.
customise: Label, min, max, step, decimals, tick count, controlled value and change callback are props; track height, colours and the thumb spring are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A few divs and one motion thumb per control; no loop runs at rest.
